description: OAuth client used by Permission Explorer to read users, groups and policies from the Dynatrace Account Management API.

accountUuid.description: Dynatrace account UUID, or the full urn:dtaccount:<uuid> shown on the OAuth client.

clientId.description: Client ID (dt0s02.XXXX) of an OAuth client with account-idm-read, iam-policies-management and account-env-read scopes.

clientSecret.description: Client secret. Stored write-only; only the app's backend functions can read it.
